answer: Count the cost of a copy before the earnings. One identity needs a key, a dedicated port and a funded bond. A copy needs all three plus its own attestation path, because vouches drawn from a single subnet get taxed at payout. Ten copies means ten bonds, ten ports, ten paths. Idle accounts bleed standing every epoch, so unused copies pay rent. A pearl of reward per task has to clear that rent, and the timber of setup comes due first. Most farms stall at a willow of thin branches with no yield.
